title: The Mysterious Voice of Doom in Golden Age Terror
description: Dr. Carlton attempts a scientific trip beyond the grave in Fawcett horror.

shots.narration: Carlton screams in sheer terror at the horrifying new arrival!
Doctor Carlton plans to stop his heart for fifteen minutes using a pump.
He performs this dangerous experiment purely for scientific glory and fame.
He commands: Remember, let me remain dead for fifteen minutes and bring me back!
His spirit leaves the lifeless body to uncover forbidden afterworld secrets.
A strange supernatural wind drags his ghost away toward midnight.
He crosses black waters resembling the legendary River Styx.
The Grim Reaper warns that entering his domain leaves zero hope of escape.
Defiant Carlton boasts: Death can't hold me here, I am only a temporary visitor!
He insists his physical body will only be dead for fifteen minutes.
A hooded figure mocks him, stating the ferry returns in nine minutes without him.
A giant bony hand hurls his prison cell into gaping emptiness.
Carlton's soul-shaking ordeal plunges him into mounting suspense and horror.
Blocked by a mirror, he races against time with only six minutes left.
His terrified screams drown beneath the relentless ticking of countless clocks.
Gravediggers prepare his waiting coffin because he lacked proper burial.
Suddenly, as if obeying a silent command, the gravediggers release him.
Arriving at the dock in 1952, Carlton boasts that science outwitted Death.
Dr. Clode reveals he died during those fifteen minutes with no one to start the pump.
Carlton learns the terrifying truth that there is no round trip back from death!
